ModMetaData.name: Essencebound v0.15 — RimWorld 1.7
ModMetaData.author: Essencebound Project
ModMetaData.description: Essencebound v0.15: Iron/Bronze/Silver/Gold/Diamond monster rank generation from colony-driven magical density, with universal lower-rank damage resistance for ranked Essencebound colonists and astral monsters. Requires Harmony. Experimental RimWorld 1.7; test saves recommended.
